title: Arkret MLS KeyPackage Operation DTOs
description: Closed request and response DTOs for self and peer MLS KeyPackage upload, claim, claim-status query, consume, and revoke operations. Individual OpenAPI components reference the $defs entries in this bundle.

object_ref.description: Opaque content-addressed or service-scoped reference. Hash-shaped refs MUST use keypackage_digest for digest bytes.

keypackage_claim_proof.description: Exactly one requester authorization proof is required by a v1 self KeyPackage claim. It reuses the generic non-Event detached-JWS wire leaf while closing audience, purpose, and domain choices for this object family; canonical binding and signer-authority rules are defined in device-lifecycle.md section 9.0.1.

key_package.description: Base64url encoding of the canonical MLS KeyPackage bytes.

cipher_suites.description: Generated from active canonical_id rows in mls-ciphersuite-registry.json.

device_signature.description: Optional defense-in-depth entry signature over the upload entry transcript registered by device-lifecycle.md section 9.0. It never replaces the required request-level batch signature.

last_resort.description: When true, this entry is a reusable last-resort KeyPackage (RFC 9420 Section 10). It remains published across claims and never enters the single-use claimed or consumed states; rotation, expiry, or explicit revocation transitions it to revoked with a registered revocation_reason. This application-layer flag is covered by the upload entry's device_signature. Optional capability gated by ak.feature.mls_last_resort_keypackage.v1. See encryption-and-audit.md section 2.6.2.

agent_id.description: Native-Agent KeyPackage branch only. MUST equal principal_id and the current AgentSignerEvidence agent identity. It is never encoded as an ak:device identifier.

agent_verification_method.description: Native-Agent runtime method that signed the exact KeyPackage; MUST match agent_key_authorize_event_id and the KeyPackage signature byte for byte.

agent_key_authorize_event_id.description: Accepted active ak.agent.key.authorize Event that binds a Native Agent runtime verification method to this KeyPackage. Mutually exclusive with device_authorize_event_id.

last_resort.description: When true, this claim record returns a reusable last-resort KeyPackage (RFC 9420 Section 10) because the single-use pool was empty. The package may be reused within the same intended_realm_id and is not transitioned to consumed; the holder MUST rotate it and trigger group updates on next online. Optional capability gated by ak.feature.mls_last_resort_keypackage.v1. See encryption-and-audit.md section 2.6.2.

keypackage_claim_record.description: Closed KeyPackage claim record. Human-device and Native-Agent branches bind their accepted authorization Event ids; the destination Principal Server claim receipt authenticates the record. No portable PCR, device, or Agent signer-evidence sidecar is accepted.

device_signature.description: Required authoritative batch signature over the typed upload request with the top-level signature and all entry signatures omitted, using the ak.self.keys.keypackages.upload.create domain. Ordinary devices and Native Agent runtimes share the same transcript.

claim_nonce.description: Requester-generated object identity carrying at least 128 bits of CSPRNG entropy. Together with requester it keys the atomic self-claim idempotency ledger.

holder_acceptance_proof.description: The single requester holder_acceptance proof for this claim. Quorum or hybrid authorization requires a separately defined future request schema and MUST NOT be inferred from this field.

self_keypackage_claim_receipt.description: Authority-signed durable receipt for a same-service KeyPackage claim. claim_request_id equals request.claim_nonce; source_service_id equals destination_service_id; request_digest covers the complete exact request including holder_acceptance_proof; claims_digest covers the exact claims array. It supplies the request-bound current AgentSignerEvidence observation transcript used by a subsequent Welcome.

requester_authorization.description: Closed human-device or Native-Agent detached authorization by the requesting participant. The signature transcript, verification-method ownership, freshness, and exact request binding are normative in device-lifecycle.md section 9.2.

target_keypackage_ref.description: Optional exact ordinary KeyPackage selector. It is mandatory for claim_purpose=direct_conversation_repair and forbidden as a best-effort hint: the owner authority atomically claims exactly this current, unconsumed package or returns the same opaque claim_failed result as every other target-side failure.

target_agent_id.description: Native-Agent exact-target branch only. MUST equal target_principal_id and the Agent identity in the returned claim record and current AgentSignerEvidence.

target_agent_verification_method.description: Native-Agent exact-target branch current runtime verification method.

target_agent_key_authorize_event_id.description: Native-Agent exact-target branch current accepted ak.agent.key.authorize Event.

peer_key_packages_claim_unsigned_request.description: Server-prepared immutable peer claim request fields before requester_authorization is attached. claim_request_id carries at least 128 bits of entropy and equals the Idempotency-Key value on the peer command.

peer_key_packages_claim_authorization_dr.description: Complete server-reserved object shown to the participant before signing. The signature transcript binds both the immutable request fields and the explicit service/trust-domain transport destination; the client MUST NOT infer transport_binding from local configuration.

target_keypackage_ref.description: Exact ordinary KeyPackage selector for replacement repair. The destination KeyPackage authority MUST reject last-resort, stale, consumed, revoked, wrong-principal, wrong-device and non-matching refs through the same opaque claim_failed surface.

request.description: The exact participant-authorized unsigned request fields. Together with request_digest, this lets the destination bind a later Welcome and Direct Conversation binding to the durable claim without trusting source-service assertions.

peer_keypackage_claim_receipt.description: Destination-service-signed durable receipt. source_service_id and request are covered by the receipt signature; request_digest additionally binds the complete transport command, including participant authorization and portable signer evidence.

keypackage_claim_terminal_receipt.description: The KeyPackage owner service signs an immutable terminal ledger fact. never_claimed is issued only after the request can no longer succeed; expired/revoked identify every formerly claimed ordinary KeyPackage. This is the portable cleanup authority for a failed Direct Conversation attempt.

peer_key_packages_claim_outcome.description: Privacy-preserving peer success response. It intentionally omits inventory counts and per-device failure information.

recipient_mls_durable_receipt.description: The exact recipient signer signs every field except signature only after durably storing and opening the Welcome and matching it to the claimed KeyPackage, Realm, group and epoch. Closed XOR: a human device binds recipient_device_id/device_verification_method; a Native Agent binds recipient_agent_id, recipient_agent_verification_method and agent_key_authorize_event_id. The claim record, Welcome recipient, KeyPackage signer and this receipt branch MUST match byte for byte; no signer-evidence sidecar is carried.

keypackage_consume_receipt.description: Owner Principal Server signed single-use CAS receipt. It embeds the exact device-or-Native-Agent-signed recipient_mls_durable_receipt so the authorized original peer claim source can recover and independently verify the complete durable proof through the consumed claim query. It is issued only after atomically transitioning every listed ordinary KeyPackage claim to consumed. Same exact consume replays this receipt; any coordinate, signer-branch or evidence mismatch conflicts.

signature.description: Signature over the typed consume request with this field omitted, using the ak.self.keys.keypackages.command.consume domain.

recipient_durable_receipt.description: Closed device-or-Native-Agent signer proof that the exact Welcome is durable. Its branch MUST match the consume requester and exact claim record. Consume MUST NOT run before this proof exists.

signature.description: Signature over the typed revoke request with this field omitted, using the ak.self.keys.keypackages.command.revoke domain.
